question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Camaraderie
solution: The correct answer is '**Dislike**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Camaraderie**' is '**Dislike**'. • **Camaraderie**: a feeling of friendship and trust among a group of people who work together or share an experience. [(साथ काम करनेवाले लोगों के बीच) परस्पर मित्रता एवं विश्‍वास की भावना; सौहार्द, पारस्परिक विश्‍वास] • *Example: A spirit of **camaraderie** is not always seen among people from the same fraternity.* • **Dislike**: to think that somebody/something is unpleasant. [(किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को) नापसंद करना] • *Example: I really **dislike** flying.* **Correct Answer:__** *Dislike.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Friendship**: a relationship between people who are friends. (मित्रता; दोस्‍ती) • **Amity**: friendly relations. (मैत्रीपूर्ण संबंध) • **Companionship**: the pleasant feeling of having a friendly relationship with somebody and not being alone. (साहचर्य, मैत्री, साथ) 33:T72d, The correct answer is** 'apologised to the teacher'.**
